stops.note: named a flour made from roasted, ground maize and chia seeds
stops.meaning: ground roasted maize or chia flour

stops.note: adopted into Mexican Spanish for the same roasted grain flour
stops.meaning: a toasted, ground maize or seed flour

stops.note: borrowed into English through Mexican and Southwestern U.S. foodways
stops.meaning: a sweetened, toasted maize flour used as a drink or snack

current_meaning: a sweetened, toasted maize flour, traditionally mixed with water as a drink or eaten as a snack
